# Phloem AI

> Phloem is a secure multi-agent orchestration layer for semantic agent handoffs, agent collaboration, and coordinated AI workflows.

## What Phloem does

- Coordinates handoffs between AI agents across vendors.
- Helps agents share context while preserving workflow boundaries.
- Provides a remote MCP connection for supported agent clients.
- Publishes setup guides for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, Linear Agents, OpenCode, Salesforce Agentforce, and VS Code Copilot.

## Machine-readable resources

- Website: https://phloem-ai.netlify.app/
- Documentation: https://phloem-ai.netlify.app/pages/about.html
- Repository: https://github.com/Phloem-AI/Phloem-core
- MCP endpoint: https://phloem-core.vercel.app/mcp
- Sitemap: https://phloem-ai.netlify.app/sitemap.xml
- Robots policy: https://phloem-ai.netlify.app/robots.txt
- Agent metadata: https://phloem-ai.netlify.app/agent.json

## Important scope

The website is a static frontend. The MCP endpoint is a separate service. Agents should follow the relevant setup guide and use the MCP endpoint only with credentials supplied by the operator.
